name: Haas-style mill (VF series)
description: Haas 3-axis vertical mill, from Haas's mill Programming Workbook (2005): % tape marks, O and a five-digit program number, G28 G91 Z0. to machine home before tool changes and at the end, G43 H on the first move after each tool change (G28 cancels it), one M code per line, a decimal point on every length and feed, dwells in seconds with their decimals (a Haas G04 P without a fraction is milliseconds). G20/G21 only check units on Haas: Setting 9 must match the program or the control alarms. Arcs are limited to half a turn per block until full circles are proven. Not yet checked on the owner's machine, whose control is newer than the workbook: prove out every program (air cut, single block).

safe_start: G17 G40 G49 G80 G90 G94 {units_code}
